name: WidgetStack
author: brodgar
description: Example addon: what a widget is and how to name it -- a live stack of the widgets under the cursor, a click-to-inspect window over hafen.ui()'s tree reads, a self-validating selector inspector that offers only selectors which actually resolve to the widget you are pointing at, and a live treeview of every widget the character has up, to expand, outline and inspect.
